speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me. I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling on your palms. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any specific patterns in when these symptoms occur, such as after eating certain foods or during stress?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies (likely crusted or generalized given the duration and occupational exposure). The combination of a pruritic rash on the face/upper body, paresthesia on the palms, and work history with rice farming and livestock strongly suggests infestation. Do you have a history of close contact with family members or coworkers who have similar symptoms, and have you noticed burrows or excoriations on your skin?
